AND (CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(H.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' OR H.EMPID LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR UPPER(H.ENGLISH_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%')

ORDER BY H.EMPID
